reason: I already land a few paid collabs a month with my rate card and invoices, so a beta from a small team I can't look up isn't worth linking my Instagram to. Nothing here says who stands behind the brands or what happens if a café ghosts my invoice.
objection: Is this a real registered company? If a business they matched me with doesn't pay, who do I complain to? Mitra 'never taking a cut' also means it has no reason to chase payment for me.
would_change_my_mind: A named company with a contact, plus some kind of payment protection or escrow for collabs booked through Mitra, and a few creators my size I recognise vouching that the brands actually paid.
